name: agent-pocket-desktop-attach
description: Local adapter that lets Agent Pocket create, read, and continue Codex Desktop tasks through authenticated Bridge IPC.

interface.shortDescription: Attach Agent Pocket to the Codex Desktop task host.
interface.longDescription: A local compatibility adapter for the running Codex Desktop task channel. User-facing plugin tools remain read-only; authenticated Agent Pocket Bridge IPC may list saved projects and create, read, or continue Codex Desktop tasks.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Agent Pocket can attach to this Codex Desktop.
List my recent Codex Desktop tasks through the attach probe.
